title: 第1075章 熊白两家第1074章 青山姑爷
slug: 说好武侠世界你怎么教人修仙
lines: 铁秋雨委婉地劝说。
铁珊瑚继续拱了拱鼻子，这下便是连他也彻底无可奈何了。
一切为了铁家寨，这才是最大的事情。
楚风新郎官还有铁珊瑚这新娘子一个个的都浑不在意这场上的婚礼，甚至完全可以说，今时今日到这里的宾客，比他们都还在意得多。
不得不说，这样种种的状况绝对是少之又少的。
而在这铁家寨子里面，此时一众宾客们齐齐前来。
白家的白磊、熊家的熊白衣，双方也都对着楚风恭恭敬敬地敬酒。
所以说他们一个个的在自家寨子里面对于铁家寨那是素来瞧不起，可现如今真正到了人家的地盘，要是还说出这样的话，那便是不知死活。
届时，甚至连他们身后的势力两大寨子，也绝不可能为他们出头的。
所谓自作孽不可活，便也就是这样的一番道理。
“实在是恭喜楚风兄弟了。今日能够成功迎娶得到这位铁家大小姐，可不知让我们青茅山的多少男儿，一个个羡煞万分。”
“楚风兄弟可是不知，铁家大小姐那可是我们青茅山第一美人。如今楚风兄弟这可是夺人所爱。不过放心，我们青茅山的人还是很大气的，绝对大力支持。来来来，喝酒，今日当浮一大白。”
众人继续酒过三巡，觥筹交错，现场这一片热闹欢腾的气氛也是彻底弥漫开来。
便是连那些上官家的一众人等，一个个的也同样没有闹事。
足以可见，铁家在这私底下给的补偿还是很有用的。
否则的话，上官家的人今日也绝对不会出面的，这也是大差不差的事言。
楚风时不时的也关注了下上官家的人，发现他们的确并没有在这里闹事情的嫌疑，随即便也转了心思。
反正天塌下来有高个子顶着。
以前都是他做师傅的顶着，现如今倒是也该让其他的人也顶顶了。
楚风也不愿意太过辛苦了。
而此刻矗立在这最前方之处的铁家家主铁正义，看着眼前的一幕，眼神之中不免的带上了些许的遗憾。
这段时间他可是派人去调查了楚风的底细的。
这不调查还好，一调查。
他对楚风便更是有几分舍不得了。
虽以是下界飞升之人，但最近一段时间的表现，即便是他这位铁家的老家主、半步大罗玄仙之境的真正战力，年轻时候那也是远远不及的。
而如果能够让这样的一位少年俊杰跟他家女儿在一起，那么未来的铁家可就不仅仅只有着大罗玄仙之境这一份传承的契机了，前途一定会变得更加美好。
只不过可惜。
他们这些做长辈的一个个在明面上关心的紧，下面做小辈的仿佛却是毫不忧心。
也令他们着实哭笑不得，否则的话，好感于情于理也都该擦出一些爱情的火花才对。
可这段时间，楚风还有铁珊瑚二人之间的相处，只能够说举案齐眉、相敬如宾。
这样的状态，要么是关系很好的朋友，要么便就是老夫老妻。
而两个人之间的关系不可能是后者，所以便只能够是前者。
这会让铁正义心里面颇有几分不太得劲，仿佛他非要把闺女给塞过去一般，可人家似乎还不领情。
他堂堂铁家，青茅山的霸主，什么时候受过这种委屈？
简直就是不像样。
铁秦风对此微微一笑：“近水楼台先得月。
年轻人之间，家主大人彼此相处的时间长了，久而久之自然是能够日久生情。
所以我们完全不必在这块急于一时。
content_en:
Tie Qiuyu persuaded tactfully.
Iron Coral continued to arch his nose, and now even he was completely helpless.
Everything is for Tiejiazhai, this is the biggest thing.
Neither Chu Feng, the groom, nor Tie Hualou, the bride, cared much about the wedding. It could even be said that the guests here today cared more about it than they did.
It has to be said that such situations are absolutely rare.
In this Tiejia Village, a group of guests came together at this time.
Bai Lei from the Bai family and Xiong Baiyi from the Xiong family also toasted respectfully to Chu Feng.
Therefore, each of them has always looked down upon Tiejiazhai in their own village, but now that they are really on their territory, if they still say such things, they are ignorant of life and death.
At that time, even the two strongholds behind them would never be able to stand up for them.
The so-called "you will not survive if you do your own misfortune", this is the truth.
"Congratulations to Brother Chu Feng. Being able to successfully marry the eldest lady of the Tie family today will make many men in Qingmao Mountain extremely envious."
"Brother Chu Feng doesn't know that the eldest lady of the Tie family is the most beautiful woman in our Qingmao Mountain. Now Brother Chu Feng is so popular. But don't worry, we people in Qingmao Mountain are still very proud and will definitely support her strongly. Come on, have a drink, today is all about you."
Everyone continued to drink and drink for three rounds, and the lively and joyful atmosphere was completely filled.
Even the people from the Shangguan family did not cause trouble one by one.
It is enough to show that the compensation given by the Tie family in private is still very useful.
Otherwise, no one from the Shangguan family would come forward today. This is quite true.
Chu Feng also paid attention to the Shangguan family from time to time, and found that they were not suspected of causing trouble here, and then he changed his mind.
Anyway, if the sky falls, there will be tall people holding it up.
In the past, he was the master who took the responsibility, but now it is time for other people to take the responsibility as well.
Chu Feng didn't want to work too hard.
At this moment, Tie Zhengyi, the head of the Tie family, who was standing at the forefront, looked at the scene in front of him, with a little regret in his eyes.
During this time, he sent people to investigate Chu Feng's details.
It would be better not to investigate, but to investigate.
He was even more reluctant to let go of Chu Feng.
Although he is a person who has ascended to the lower world, his performance in recent times, even the real combat power of the old head of the Tie family and a half-step Da Luo Xuanxian, is far inferior to that of his youth.
And if such a young hero can be allowed to be with his daughter, then the future Tie family will not only have the opportunity to inherit the realm of Daluo Xuanxian, but the future will definitely become even better.
It's just a pity.
The elders were all very concerned on the surface, but the juniors below seemed not to be worried at all.
It also makes them really dumbfounded. Otherwise, good feelings and emotions should create some sparks of love.
But during this period of time, the relationship between Chu Feng and Tie Hualu could only be described as equal and respectful to each other.
In this state, they are either very good friends or an old married couple.
The relationship between two people cannot be the latter, so it can only be the former.
This makes Tie Zhengyi feel quite unhappy, as if he insists on pushing his daughter in, but he doesn't seem to appreciate it.
When did he, the mighty Tie family, the overlord of Qingmao Mountain, ever suffer such injustice?
Simply unseemly.
Tie Qinfeng smiled slightly at this: "The first to get the moon is the tower near the water.
As young people and family heads spend more time with each other, they will naturally become more in love with each other over time.
So we don't have to rush here at all.
